title.narrative: Reinforcing the capacity of employers¿ organisations, particularly in least developed countries, to build an economy that works for all in the post-COVID era. (Business@Work)

description.narrative:
The aim of this Action is to reinforce the capacity of employers¿ and business organisations, particularly in least developed countries, in policymaking and public-private dialogue, and to specifically promote the inclusion of EBMOs in national, regional, and international public policy formulation.

 

In its role as the voice of business and the employer community, the IOE guides EBMOs,

-       to engage as responsible partners in the development process,

-       to guide investment in areas critical to sustainable development,

-       to advocate for enabling domestic and international conditions for an inclusive and sustainable private sector, such as transparent and stable rules and standards, and free and fair competition, which are conducive to achieving national development policies.
